title: How each Bible renders a lemma
rights: Derived; each edition keeps its own licence — see content/concepts/glossary/<pkg>.json
note: For each Strong’s lemma, the word each Bible uses most in the verses the King James tags with it, with the count and the number of verses. A measurement of the text, not a lexical claim: a word here is what that Bible says in those verses, which is why it needs no second witness. The glossary in src/data/names.js is the separate, confirmed layer and does carry one.
